messages:
maya: Heads-up: webinar next Tues — need updated bench claims + routing play for inbound leads. Short thread: bench numbers, 2 hero soundbites, and SDR routing map. Can we land this today? :calendar:
raj: I can pull qps/latency/cost per 1k tokens for hosted vs dedicated by EOD. Any specific models or workloads?
maya: Top two: convo/chat (context 2k tokens) and embeddings (batch 64). Use recent Redwood-opt runs with quantization baseline. Want clear delta vs managed cloud endpoints.
tori: Will also run a small latency tail test for warm vs cold starts. ETA 3pm. @raj can you make a quick chart? :bar_chart: 
raj: Yep. I'll drop a CSV and a screenshot. Also: recommended soundbite: 'same quality, 40% lower per-token cost at p95 latency' — want to be cautious on exact numbers.
maya: Agree. We need safe ranges and an evidence note: 'bench run details in the appendix'.
sam: For SDR routing: proposal is tag leads with 'webinar-bench' + 'region' + 'priority' then route to the Field-ops playbook. Quick mapping below:
```
{
  "webinar-bench": true,
  "region": "NA|EU|APAC",
  "priority": "hot|warm|cold"
}
---> Route:
hot -> AE-assign immediate
warm -> nurture-sequence + SDR-reachout
cold -> email drip
```
sam: Can we make that a simple webhook in the landing page? @jordan
jordan: Yep — can add a hidden input that sets tags and fires to /webhook/lead-routes. Will need final field names.
maya: Perfect. Also need two hero lines for battlecard: 1) 'Production-first inference controls latency and unit cost' 2) 'Unified serving across hosted->dedicated->private' — feedback?
tori: Shorten #1: 'Controls latency and halves unit cost' — again be cautious. Maybe 'significantly reduces unit cost'.
maya: Change to 'reduces unit cost by up to 50% under common workloads' — we'll call it 'up to' and link to appendix.
raj: Uploading CSV + screenshot now. Filenames: bench_chat_2k_3312345678.csv, p95_chart_3312345678.png
launchbot: Deploy reminder: update webinar landing page copy and add webhook before 10:00 tomorrow. :robot_face:
maya: Thanks team — I'll update the battlecard draft and share for a final pass at 5pm. If no blockers we'll ship to SDRs tomorrow morning. :rocket:
